free_tier.stated: no free tier: Model APIs are pay per token with no idle GPU cost; dedicated endpoints bill per second and BYOG is bring-your-own-GPU

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client pointed at the Friendli serverless endpoint
chaining: pairs with an OpenAI-compatible agent on a paid per-token balance

limits.value: text models billed per processed token, audio models per processed second; no free allowance

binding_note: no free tokens published; payment binds first

identity_cost.detail: self-serve Model APIs are started from the Friendli suite; signup details not stated on the docs pages read

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: Model APIs are pay per token with no GPU management
evidence.quote: Friendli Model APIs let you access frontier open-source models through a ready-to-use API endpoint—no deployment required, and you pay only for what you use.

notes: the self-serve API exists but is paid; no free inference allowance appears on the pricing or docs page.
